title: Try elsewhere
text: Try elsewhere. This turned out to be a piece of junk.  It cooked adequately, not well; each kind of snack had to be tinkered with to get the right cooking time to get it cooked but not burned --  the instruction book was of little help.  After using it 5-10 times, it just wouldn't.  I plugged it in, set the time, and it just did nothing.  There was no warning it was about to quit working.  Avoid this product.
